the xylem architecture, as a whole, is a dynamic and adaptive system, which is capable of adjusting to changes in the hydraulic resistance of different branches.
the xylem architecture in small plants is not random and can be explained by the need to achieve equal hydraulic resistance of each leaf in the crown.
the equi-resistive principle is a general feature of the xylematic network of trees, even in small trees.
